game_title: GOD OF WAR: SONS OF SPARTA

beats.label: hook
beats.text: Santa Monica shadow-dropped a 2D Metroidvania God of War at State of Play — a prequel set before Kratos ever left Greece, before the legend, before the rage.

beats.label: gameplay
beats.text: Play as a young Kratos alongside his brother Deimos — two Spartan warriors in ancient Greece before everything went wrong. Classic 2D action meets Metroidvania progression: unlock new combat abilities and movement skills, revisit earlier areas, and piece together the origins of Kratos's rage.

beats.label: standout
beats.text: Chronologically the first God of War story ever told — developed by Mega Cat Studios with Santa Monica Studio. A bold 2D art style and original Greek mythology storyline fills in the franchise's biggest gap. This is where Kratos begins.

beats.label: cta
beats.text: God of War: Sons of Sparta is out now exclusively on PS5 — shadow-dropped at PlayStation State of Play.
